title: The Balance Beam Eve
skyStory: The spring equinox arrives this evening: day and night stand exactly equal, like two people sharing a seesaw perfectly. The gibbous moon, ninety-six percent lit, has slid into Virgo and is busy straightening the sky's tablecloth for tomorrow. Everything must be just so. The Fire Tiger's birthday party starts at midnight, and the moon has a clipboard.

reading: The equinox is a door swinging open: light and dark balanced for one breath before the light wins. You were born on this hinge, and tonight it creaks for you. Expect to feel strangely calm, even with ten things in motion.

Spend the evening the way a hinge would: still, steady, letting the door swing. Wear the onyx on your left wrist tonight, the receiving side, and resist the urge to switch it to the right. Tomorrow is about receiving. Practise. The [[Temperance]] card is pouring water between two cups without spilling a drop, and tonight that is you.
joel.mission: Keep the onyx bracelet on your left wrist all evening and do not switch it, no matter how strong the urge.
joel.omen: An egg balancing on its end, a coin landing on its edge, or anything in perfect balance. It means you are ready.

reading: You were born on the solstice, the longest night, and Joel on the equinox, the balance point. Tonight the wheel turns to his day. The mountain holds steady while the fire gets ready to blaze.

There is something you want to send him at midnight, or first thing in the morning. Write it tonight while the equinox light is still in the sky. Be specific. Be warm. Be ridiculous if you want. The [[Six of Swords]] reminds you that he has been helping you row all year. Tomorrow you get to hand him an oar of a different kind: words he will keep.
nancy.mission: Write your birthday message for Joel tonight, read it out loud once to check the rhythm, then schedule it.
nancy.omen: Light and shadow splitting a room exactly in half. It means two forces are perfectly balanced, and good things follow.
nancy.stoneWhy: his receiving stone, held for him

together.text: Equinox night. At sunset, wherever you are, pause for a single breath and think of the other. Light and dark are equal right now, mountain and fire are equal right now. Tomorrow the light wins. Get ready.

game.intro: Equinox eve. Day and night are on the balance beam and the tabloids are camped outside.
game.headline: DAY AND NIGHT CAUGHT ___ ON BALANCE BEAM, SATURN DEMANDS RECOUNT
